basis.text: Lumateperone was granted Fast Track Designation in 2017, based on the premise that it is better tolerated than approved drugs for schizophrenia

citations.quote: Lumateperone was granted Fast Track Designation in 2017.

In September 2017, the Applicant submitted requests for both Fast Track and Breakthrough Therapy Designations, based on the premise that lumateperone is better-tolerated than approved drugs for the treatment of schizophrenia.

summary.text: Lumateperone was submitted via the 505(b)(1) pathway for schizophrenia in adults and was granted Fast Track Designation in 2017, which supported a rolling review; the Breakthrough Therapy request was denied over nonclinical safety concerns. A planned Advisory Committee Meeting was cancelled after a Major Amendment extended the goal date, and the NDA was approved December 27, 2019.
